title: AppInstance
description: Schema v7-arc — App Instance: local realization of a Spec on one specific bot. Never travels. See internal/spec-manifest-v7-2026-05-20.md §4.

instance_id.description: Stable Instance identifier on this bot. Distinct from spec_id. Migration mints i-<8hex>; native writes (Slice 3a) reuse the legacy app slug so the manifests/<id>.json filename, admin URLs, and load_manifest keys survive the shape flip unchanged.

app_id.description: AL-1.4a canonical identity. Populate-on-absent from the legacy chain (pkg_id > id > spec_id > instance_id), so in 1.4a it mirrors instance_id and no reader's answer changes. Optional: a scanner-born draft carries draft_id instead, and an id that is not a conforming slug is left unstamped rather than silently rewritten into one no marker/filename/coverage key uses. AL-1.5/1.4c collapse this onto provenance.spec_id (design §3: an instance is the pair (app_id, bot_id)).

draft_id.description: Scanner-assigned draft identity for a DISCOVERED app (design §3). Explicitly unstable — the scanner may merge, rename or drop the draft freely — and never appears in attribution, access or sharing. Mutually exclusive with app_id: identity is conferred by promotion, not by discovery.

bot_id.description: The bot that owns this Instance.

source_pod_id.description: Null if locally-original; non-null if imported from another pod.

source_bot_id.description: Originating bot if shared from elsewhere.

forked_from.description: instance_id of source if installed from a sibling Instance rather than a fresh Spec.

prior_spec_ids.description: Append-only supersession chain (oldest→newest), excluding the current spec_id. Populated when the app is rebuilt under a fresh spec_id (forge re-create / scanner re-discovery) so a marker carrying a retired id still resolves to this Instance. Absent reads as []. See spec §5.

spec_version_history.description: Updated by Adopt phase whenever Spec version changes affect this Instance.

optional_missing.description: IDs of optional deps not satisfied at install; runtime may degrade for features that need them.

file_id.description: Marker file_id in '<id>@<version>' format (version is YYYY.MM.DD-major.minor).

marker_state.description: Lifecycle state per provenance.py taxonomy, plus 'deprecated' for uninstall.

created_in_session.description: Optional session ID that created this file.

resolved_cron.description: Actual cron line in effect on this bot (may differ from Spec.cron_default per local timezone or user adjustment).

learned_config.description: Free-form, LLM-managed configuration that has accumulated over the Instance's life.

evidence_files.description: Preserved-from-v13. Operator-curated paths to evidence files (logs / sample outputs / fixtures) for this Instance. 73% of real v13 manifests populate this; Tier-2 audit reads them.

last_audit.description: Preserved-from-v13 (schema v12). Tier-3 audit run stamp. Auto-populated by audit_runner.py; preserved here so the daemon's last-known state survives the v7 migration boundary.

last_structural_verify.description: Preserved-from-v13 (schema v11). Tier-2 structural-audit stamp. Auto-populated by audit_runner.py — preserved so the daemon doesn't need a forced re-run after migration.

audit_trail_path.description: Preserved-from-v13 (schema v11). Absolute path on the bot to the per-app rolling audit log JSONL. Bot-local — stays on Instance, not Spec.

usage.description: Native-write passthrough (Slice 3a). The bot-facing usage manual (trigger_recognition, how_to_use, model) — drives INSTALLED_APPS.md discoverability. Per-bot, so Instance-owned; the migration folded v13 usage into learned_config instead, but fresh apps must not lose the structured manual.

improvement_history.description: Native-write passthrough (Slice 3a). Forge build/approval records. The migration dropped this as a deliberate watermark; a freshly installed app has exactly one entry — the provenance of this very install — and keeps it.

app_files_privacy.description: Native-write passthrough (Slice 3a). v15 backup data-classification tier for app files. Bot-local paths posture, so Instance-owned.

data_paths.description: Native-write passthrough (Slice 3a). v15 backup data-classification path rules. Bot-local, so Instance-owned.

default_for_unclassified.description: Native-write passthrough (Slice 3a). v15 backup data-classification default for paths no rule matches.

app_kind.description: Schema v25 (app-scan bite D1); v26 (Slice 2) added 'system'. Purpose/fit label: goal-application vs capability/skill vs pod-runtime infrastructure. Native-write passthrough — Instance-owned (the per-bot scanner reads/writes it and the Apps grid loads it). Inert default 'application' when absent (an un-classified Instance stays an app).

definition_status.description: Schema v27 — the Defined/Discovered source-of-truth axis (internal/spec-apps-meta-2026-06-13.md §9). Distinct from 'status' (lifecycle) and the Spec's creation provenance. 'discovered' = scanner-owned churnable draft; 'defined' = operator-vouched contract (existence-shielded from L3 archival, anchored-identity fields marked authored). Native-write passthrough — Instance-owned (per-bot vouch; the scanner reads it and the archival shield keys on it). Absent reads as 'discovered' (the safe default).

classification.description: Schema v25 (app-scan bite D1); v26 (Slice 2) added 'system' to the enums and 'classifier_version'. Audit/idempotency block the scanner's purpose/fit classifier writes. Its presence-and-currency means the Instance has been judged at the current classifier_version; absence or an older version means it will be (re)judged next scan. Native-write passthrough — Instance-owned.

classifier_version.description: The classifier vocabulary/prompt version that produced this verdict (purpose_classifier.CLASSIFIER_VERSION). The reconcile pass re-judges any block stamped below the current version. Absent on v1/#2899 blocks (treated as version 0).

raw_kind.description: The model's raw verdict when it was overridden in the conservative direction (a 'capability' or 'system' verdict below its confidence threshold downgraded to 'application').

privacy.description: Per-instance privacy overlay (same shape as the Spec's privacy block). Carries answers that belong to THIS install — e.g. the add-bot wizard's consent_notice/opt_out_command merged into the v24 manifest at install — whenever the bound Spec's block does not reproduce them. Hydration prefers this block over the Spec's.

shareable_in_lessons.description: Gates whether observations from this app may appear in shareable Lessons artifacts.

audience_scoping.description: Per-instance audience-scoping overlay (same shape as the Spec's audience_scoping block). Carries the boundary the install conversation decided (add-bot audience_scoping_seed) whenever it differs from the bound Spec's. Hydration prefers this block over the Spec's.

operator.description: Top-level audience class for the app.

approved_surfaces.description: Allowed surface IDs (e.g., 'telegram_dm', 'slack_channel'). Vocabulary is open in v1.

role_capabilities.description: Role name → capability list. Role names and capability vocabulary are open in v1.

operator_bypasses.description: Bypass identifiers permitting operator overrides. Vocabulary is open in v1.

change_log.description: Append-only audit trail. Never deleted; periodic compression rolls qualifying entries into Lessons.

who.description: Actor that performed the change. When bot acts in response to user instruction, who='bot' with user_intent_quote set separately.

user_intent_quote.description: Verbatim or paraphrased user instruction when applicable.

signal_type.description: Vocabulary aligns with the signal store (e.g., user_request, error_threshold, scheduled).

drift_log.description: Schema v28 — drift-narrative log (internal/spec-apps-meta-2026-06-13.md §9.3). Append-only list of MAJOR scanner-observed drift the Phase-6 reconcile pass appends for a 'defined' Instance (a 'discovered' Instance is a churnable draft and gets no narrative). DISTINCT from 'change_log' above: change_log is the forge/capability audit trail compressed into Lessons; drift_log is the operator's post-hoc review of significant manifest-vs-reality drift. Native-write passthrough — Instance-owned. Inert default [] (absent = 'no major drift observed').

kind.description: The shape of the drift: a target appeared, disappeared, or meaningfully changed.

target.description: The drifted surface's identity (file path, cron label, scheduled_action id, or dependency name).

significance.description: Only 'major' drift is ever logged; minor (data/doc) drift is absorbed silently. The field is explicit for forward-compat.

summary.description: One-line human-readable narration of the change.

reviewed.description: False when first appended; the operator marks it true once reviewed (Bite 4). The count of reviewed:false entries is the tile badge's data source.

source.description: Discriminator: this entry was minted by the scanner's drift classifier (vs any future producer).

classifier.description: Which classification path judged this drift major. Audit/idempotency aid.

last_reflect_at.description: Last time the Reflect phase ran against this Instance.
